notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
The Thirteenth Doctor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
